audio.t: Do you know if Professor Lin is holding office hours this week?

questions.explain: 問的是「這週有沒有 office hours」，A 直接回答時間。B 用 hold 做同音陷阱；C 回答地點，沒回答「有沒有」。
options: I'll hold the door for her.
Her office is on the third floor.

audio.t: Why didn't you sign up for the statistics elective?

questions.explain: Why 問句要回答原因。clash with = 時間衝堂。C 用 sign 重複字干擾，但意思是「簽名」。
options: It clashes with my lab section.

audio.t: Could you send me the link to the course waitlist form?

questions.explain: 請求句 Could you…? 最自然的回應是答應並說明做法。B、C 分別拿 wait、link 做字面陷阱。
options: Sure, I'll email it to you right now.
The wait was about twenty minutes.

audio.t: Hi, I'm trying to add Introduction to Data Science, but the system says the class is full.
Right, it's capped at sixty because of the computer lab. But you can join the waitlist. Students usually drop in the first week.
How will I know if I get in?
You'll get an email, and you'll have twenty-four hours to confirm your spot.

questions.explain: 男生最後說 you'll have twenty-four hours to confirm，換句話說就是 within a day。題目常用同義改寫。

We mainly went over the syllabus, and it's posted online. But groups for the term project will be formed next Tuesday, so make sure you're there.

questions.explain: 教授提到大綱在網路上，並強調下週二要分組 make sure you're there。B 是對話中的背景細節，C 時間錯（是下週二、且是在課堂上分組）。
options: Read the syllabus and attend next Tuesday.
Form a project group by himself today.

audio.t: Attention, all students. Because of scheduled system maintenance this weekend, the deadline for dropping a course without a W on your transcript has been moved from this Friday to next Monday at 5 p.m. Please note that online drop requests will not be available from Saturday morning until Sunday night.

questions.explain: 開頭 Because of scheduled system maintenance 直接給原因。廣播題通常第一句就交代主旨。
options: The registration system will be under maintenance.
A new course has been added.

audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone. I'm Dr. Chen from the Academic Advising Center. Before you finalize your schedules, I'd like to talk about credit load. Our university requires first-year students to take between sixteen and twenty-five credits each semester. If you want to go above twenty-five, you'll need written approval from your department chair, and honestly, I don't recommend it in your first term.

Many of you are also considering EMI courses, that is, courses taught in English. These count toward the university's bilingual certificate, and they're a great way to build academic English. But they usually involve more reading, so balance them with courses in subjects you already feel confident about.

One more thing. If you start to struggle, don't wait until midterms. Our peer tutoring program is free, and you can book a session through the student portal. Our office is open until seven on weekdays, so feel free to drop by after class.

questions.explain: 提到 first-year students 的學分規定、your first term，可推知聽眾是新生。
questions.prompt: Who is the speaker most likely talking to?

head: From: Kevin Huang (Teaching Assistant)

passage: For years, students at the main library have complained about the "study-room scramble": arriving early, only to find every group room already taken, often by a single person with a laptop. Starting this semester, the library has replaced its paper sign-up sheet with an app called RoomSpot.

Through RoomSpot, groups of three or more can reserve one of the library's 24 study rooms up to seven days in advance, for a maximum of three hours per day. Users must check in by scanning a QR code on the door within 15 minutes of their booking's start time; otherwise, the room is released to others. Individual students may still use a room, but only when no group has booked it.

Early data suggest the system is working. According to library director Grace Lee, room use during peak hours rose from 71 percent to 93 percent in the first month, and complaints dropped sharply. "Rooms are finally being used for what they were built for: working together," she said.

Not everyone is satisfied, however. Some graduate students argue that the three-hour limit makes it hard to prepare for long thesis meetings. International students also pointed out that the app was at first available only in Chinese; an English version was added in the second week after the International Student Association raised the issue.
The library plans to review the policy at the end of the semester and is collecting suggestions through an online survey.

questions.explain: 全文介紹 RoomSpot 訂位系統、成效與反對意見，B 最完整。
options: A new study-room booking system and how people have reacted
How to prepare for a thesis meeting
The renovation of the main library
